messages:
samira: dropping PR #4388 — condensed quickstart + migration appendix for SDK v1.0. includes Python/TS snippets and a short examples gallery. planning to merge in the 16:00 PT docs slot. reviewers?
noah: I can review tone/terminology. flag: swap 'tenant' -> 'workspace' and avoid 'customers' when we mean SDK users. prefer 'developers' or 'engineers'.
rene: I'll do code and examples. note: please use `Client.from_env()` and don't show inline keys. streaming snippets should be generator-style.
style-guard-bot: style-check: replace two instances of 'simple' with 'straightforward' or more specific guidance. flag passive voice in migration step 4.
samira: updated snippets to `Client.from_env()`, fixed the passive voice, and converted streaming examples to generator loops. added a tiny before/after table for route flags.
ci-bot: Preview build failed: anchor link error in migration-appendix.md -> '#routing-fallbacks' not found.
samira: ack, fixing header id now and pushing.
preview-bot: preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4388 — please check code rendering, table layout, and tone.
noah: tone pass done: softened imperatives ("Run the script" -> "You can run the script"), changed 'simple' -> 'straightforward', and adjusted voice to present tense. left one punctuation nit in a bullet.
rene: code pass: changed streaming snippet to generator form and added an inline backpressure comment. suggested logging error.code in the example instead of printing the whole exception. non-blocking.
samira: pushed the punctuation fix and added the logging note. added a short rollback command to the runbook.
ci-bot: Docs build succeeded — 0 warnings.
preview-bot: final preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/PR-4388 (visual checks green).
noah: approved from docs POV.
rene: approved from code POV, left an optional suggestion on error wording.
samira: thanks everyone — merging at 16:10 PT (10-minute buffer) unless objections.
noah: approved, go for merge.
rene: thumbs up.
samira: merged PR #4388 :tada: — appreciate the quick style and code passes, reads much cleaner for engineers.
